scope: Two FP6 carrier profiles on the German Vodafone and Telefónica networks, plus an isolated Pixel 2 peer for ordinary bidirectional voice and SMS checks. This matrix does not claim national coverage or custom-OS compatibility.
evidence_policy: Carrier documentation establishes plan eligibility only. PASS or FAIL requires build-bound device evidence from the stated SIM/default-subscription arrangement; unavailable or untested behavior remains NOT_RUN or BLOCKED.

sources.claim: Vodafone's current CallYa Classic offer describes ordinary voice, SMS, data, VoLTE, WiFi Calling and 5G eligibility; actual provisioning and FP6 behavior still require observation.
Vodafone lists CallYa Classic among tariffs with WiFi Calling and states device and connection prerequisites and emergency-call limitations.
Vodafone's current CallYa information describes WiFi Calling, 5G eligibility and device or coverage conditions for prepaid service.
Vodafone documents prepaid eSIM activation and management; deletion or reprovisioning is outside unattended testing.

Blau identifies its no-package prepaid base arrangement as Blau 9 Cent, with ordinary domestic voice, SMS and metered data available from prepaid balance; this does not establish IMS or radio-access behavior.
Blau states that VoWiFi is generally available to eligible contract and prepaid tariffs when the device, tariff and Wi-Fi prerequisites are met.

Blau's current official pages contain inconsistent prepaid 5G wording, while the selected no-package 9 Cent page does not establish 5G entitlement; the active base tariff therefore remains unverified for 5G.
Blau describes VoLTE calling and continued SMS support on modern network service; this does not prove provisioning for the selected tariff.

profiles.apn_context: Stock automatic configuration; cellular data path verified; APN values not recorded
profiles.ims_context: Private stock phone and registry context captured; ordinary LTE and Wi-Fi calls both passed with active-call, IMS and radio-transport evidence

profiles.plan_name: Blau 9 Cent base tariff; no package option active
profiles.apn_context: Stock automatic dual-SIM configuration captured; bounded mobile-data behavior verified
profiles.ims_context: Private dual-SIM phone and registry context captured; ordinary LTE and Wi-Fi calls both passed with active-call, IMS and radio-transport evidence

capability_rows.notes: Ordinary calls passed in both directions with the permanent peer; earpiece and speaker audio were confirmed and connected-call captures recorded LTE voice service and IMS registration.
Unique synthetic non-personal messages were delivered successfully in both directions with the permanent peer.
On locked stock FP6.QREL.16.100.0, the default route changed from Wi-Fi to cellular, a bounded HTTPS request returned HTTP 200 with a 559-byte body, and the starting Wi-Fi route was restored.

During an ordinary outbound call with Wi-Fi off, the operator confirmed concurrent mobile-data loading and two-way audio; private capture recorded active off-hook state, in-service voice/data, LTE voice RAT and IMS registration.
With airplane mode on and approved Wi-Fi connected, an ordinary call passed with the stock Wi-Fi Calling indicator, two-way audio, active off-hook state, IMS registration and IWLAN/WLAN evidence.

The stock telephony display state reported LTE with an NR_NSA override while the verified default route was cellular and the bounded HTTPS request passed. This is a local display-state observation, not proof that every byte used NR or a national coverage claim.

In an explicitly authorized bounded procedure on locked stock FP6.QREL.16.100.0, the installed profile was disabled through Android Settings, reached a verified unregistered service state, was re-enabled without activation credentials, and returned to registered service. Deletion, download, transfer and reprovisioning were not tested.
Ordinary calls passed in both directions with the permanent peer; earpiece and speaker audio were confirmed and connected-call captures recorded LTE voice service and IMS registration.
Unique synthetic non-personal messages were delivered successfully in both directions with the permanent peer.

With explicit operator authorization on locked stock FP6.QREL.16.100.0, Blau was temporarily selected for mobile data, Wi-Fi was disabled, a cellular default route returned HTTP 200 with a 559-byte HTTPS body, and both Wi-Fi and the Vodafone data default were restored and verified. This does not establish 5G or IMS behavior.

Actual selected-plan behavior passed: with Blau selected for voice and data and Wi-Fi off, an ordinary call retained a successful data load and private capture recorded active off-hook state, LTE voice RAT and IMS registration.
With airplane mode on and approved Wi-Fi connected, an ordinary call passed with the stock Wi-Fi Calling indicator, two-way audio, active off-hook state, IMS registration and IWLAN/WLAN evidence.

The reviewed official material does not consistently establish 5G eligibility for the active no-package 9 Cent base tariff. No device pass or failure is inferred; retest only if a clearly 5G-eligible option is activated.

dual_sim.reason: With both profiles active on locked stock FP6.QREL.16.100.0, the operator observed Vodafone selected for all three Android default-subscription settings after the bounded dual-SIM context capture.

peer.limitations: The permanent LTE-only peer passed ordinary bidirectional voice and SMS interoperability; it is not used to qualify FP6 5G or WiFi Calling.
